title: Late Changes to Booked Mobile In-Home Collection Visits — Scheduling System Reference
content:
## The change and its charge

A home visit moved on its appointment date or on the calendar day before it carries one late-change charge, posted as an assessed late-cancellation fee when the visit is moved and worked out by calculation rather than as the flat late-cancellation fee. This applies to a booked Mobile In-Home Collection Visit of **Specimen Collection Appointments** that the patient asks to move to a new date and start time.

A home visit is not moved to a new date until every home visit of the patient recorded as a no-show carries a no-show fee that is paid or waived, a no-show on a recollection visit excepted because it carries no fee.

Restated on the records: the booked home visit keeps its date until the fee record of each of the patient's home visits recorded as a no-show, other than a recollection visit, shows a no-show fee together with its payment or its waiver.

## Scheduling tool: `reschedule_home_visit_6b0b2488`

**Capability.** Moves a booked home (mobile in-home) collection visit to a new date and start time and posts the late-change charge it carries. One call sets the visit's appointment date and start time to the new values, adds one to the number of times the visit has been rescheduled, and, when `fee_amount` is above 0.00, adds one assessed late-cancellation fee line dated today and raises the visit's outstanding collection-fee balance by it. The visit stays booked.

**Invocation.** An agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `reschedule_home_visit_6b0b2488` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `visit_id` | The reference number of the booked home visit being moved, read from the visit lookup for the patient | Identifier |
| `appointment_date` | The new visit date the patient asks for | YYYY-MM-DD, local calendar date of the visit |
| `appointment_time` | The new start of the arrival window the patient asks for | HH:MM, 24-hour, local time of the site |
| `fee_amount` | The late-change charge to post with the move, in USD | 2 decimal places (cents); 0.00 when the move carries no charge, in which case no fee line is posted |

**Return.** A receipt with `visit_id` (the visit moved), `appointment_date` (the new date, YYYY-MM-DD), `appointment_time` (the new start, HH:MM), `reschedule_count` (the times the visit has now been rescheduled), `visit_event_id` (the reference number of the late-change fee line, empty when no charge was posted), `fee_amount` (the charge posted, USD, 2 decimal places) and `fee_balance` (the visit's outstanding collection-fee balance in USD after the move). A receipt carrying the new `appointment_date` means the visit was moved.
